decision.reasoning_trace: The user was looking for a high-quality, reliable primary backpack. While several options were evaluated, none perfectly met the criteria. The G4Free Tactical (prod_backpacks_050) had appealing features but concerns about zipper and strap durability in student/daily reviews. The ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is an excellent, highly-rated value choice, but its ultra-lightweight, packable design lacks the organizational structure and padding needed for a dedicated daily-use bag. The USWE Hajker (prod_backpacks_125) offers the premium features and durability sought, but at over $200, it is a significant investment for a 30L pack. Given the choice between potential quality issues in the mid-range and an extremely high price for the premium tier, no purchase was made during this session.
